dbqueries.dbquery: select tp.position_id, tp.position_title, tp.position_code, tp.position_referal_fees, tp.position_date_created,tp.position_priority,tp.position_code,tp.position_publish_date, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tdgr.degree_title SEPARATOR ', ') AS education, (select group_concat(tpsk.skill) from tp_skills tpsk WHERE tpsk.skill_id in (select tppsk.skill_id from tp_position_skills tppsk where tppsk.position_id=tp.position_id and tppsk.skill_type=?)) as primary_skills, (select group_concat(tpsk.skill) from tp_skills tpsk where tpsk.skill_id in (select tppsk.skill_id from tp_position_skills tppsk where tppsk.position_id=tp.position_id and tppsk.skill_type=?)) as secondary_skills, (select group_concat(tu.user_fname, ' ', tu.user_lname separator ', ') from tp_users tu left join tp_user_roles tur on (tu.user_id = tur.user_id) WHERE tu.user_id in (select tpsu.user_id from tp_position_step_users tpsu where tpsu.position_id=tp.position_id ) and tur.role_id in (?, ?) ) as contact_person, concat(case when ceil(tp.position_min_exp)=floor(tp.position_min_exp) then round(tp.position_min_exp, 0) else format(tp.position_min_exp, 1) end, ' to ', case when ceil(tp.position_max_exp)=floor(tp.position_max_exp) then round(tp.position_max_exp, 0) else format(tp.position_max_exp, 1) end, ' yrs') as experience, (tp.position_no_of_openings - (select count(*) from tp_applicant_joining_history ta where ta.position_id = tp.position_id) ) as unfilled_vacancies,tp.requirements,tp.responsibilities FROM tp_positions tp LEFT JOIN tp_position_degrees tpd ON (tpd.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_degrees tdgr ON (tdgr.degree_id=tpd.degree_id) WHERE tp.position_status = ? AND tp.is_published_for_emp_portal = ? AND tp.employee_publish_from_date <= ? AND tp.employee_publish_to_date >= ? @@ GROUP BY tp.position_id ORDER BY @@ LIMIT ?, ?

select tp.position_id, tp.position_title, tp.position_code, tp.position_referal_fees, tp.position_date_created,tp.position_priority,tp.position_code,tp.position_publish_date, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tdgr.degree_title SEPARATOR ', ') AS education, (select group_concat(tpsk.skill) from tp_skills tpsk WHERE tpsk.skill_id in (select tppsk.skill_id from tp_position_skills tppsk where tppsk.position_id=tp.position_id and tppsk.skill_type=?)) as primary_skills, (select group_concat(tpsk.skill) from tp_skills tpsk where tpsk.skill_id in (select tppsk.skill_id from tp_position_skills tppsk where tppsk.position_id=tp.position_id and tppsk.skill_type=?)) as secondary_skills, (select group_concat(tu.user_fname, ' ', tu.user_lname separator ', ') from tp_users tu left join tp_user_roles tur on (tu.user_id = tur.user_id) WHERE tu.user_id in (select tpsu.user_id from tp_position_step_users tpsu where tpsu.position_id=tp.position_id ) and tur.role_id in (?, ?) ) as contact_person, concat(case when ceil(tp.position_min_exp)=floor(tp.position_min_exp) then round(tp.position_min_exp, 0) else format(tp.position_min_exp, 1) end, ' to ', case when ceil(tp.position_max_exp)=floor(tp.position_max_exp) then round(tp.position_max_exp, 0) else format(tp.position_max_exp, 1) end, ' yrs') as experience, (tp.position_no_of_openings - (select count(*) from tp_applicant_joining_history ta where ta.position_id = tp.position_id) ) as unfilled_vacancies,tp.requirements,tp.responsibilities FROM tp_positions tp LEFT JOIN tp_position_degrees tpd ON (tpd.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_locations tpl ON (tpl.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_degrees tdgr ON (tdgr.degree_id=tpd.degree_id) WHERE tp.position_status = ? AND tp.is_published_for_emp_portal = ? AND tp.employee_publish_from_date <= ? AND tp.employee_publish_to_date >= ? @@ GROUP BY tp.position_id ORDER BY @@ LIMIT ?, ?
SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM tp_positions tp WHERE tp.position_status=? AND tp.is_published_for_emp_portal = ? AND tp.employee_publish_from_date <= ? AND tp.employee_publish_to_date >= ? @@

select tp.position_id, tp.position_title,tp.position_referal_fees,tp.position_code, tp.position_date_created,tp.position_priority,tp.position_publish_date,tp.employee_apply_refer, tp.employee_can_email, (tp.position_no_of_openings - (select count(*) from tp_applicant_joining_history ta where ta.position_id = tp.position_id ) ) as unfilled_vacancies, date_format(tp.position_date_expiry, '%d-%b-%y') as expiry_date, (select group_concat(tpsk.skill) from tp_skills tpsk where tpsk.skill_id in (select tppsk.skill_id from tp_position_skills tppsk where tppsk.position_id=tp.position_id and tppsk.skill_type=?)) as primary_skills, (select group_concat(tpsk.skill) from tp_skills tpsk where tpsk.skill_id in (select tppsk.skill_id from tp_position_skills tppsk where tppsk.position_id=tp.position_id and tppsk.skill_type=?)) as secondary_skills, concat(case when ceil(tp.position_min_exp)=floor(tp.position_min_exp) then round(tp.position_min_exp, 0) else format(tp.position_min_exp, 1) end, ' to ', case when ceil(tp.position_max_exp)=floor(tp.position_max_exp) then round(tp.position_max_exp, 0) else format(tp.position_max_exp, 1) end, ' yrs') as experience, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tdgr.degree_title SEPARATOR ', ') AS education, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tb.branch_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS branches, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tl.location_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS locations, tp.requirements,tp.responsibilities from tp_positions tp LEFT JOIN tp_position_degrees tpd ON (tpd.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_degrees tdgr ON (tdgr.degree_id=tpd.degree_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_branches tpb ON (tpb.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_branches tb ON (tb.branch_id=tpb.branch_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_locations tpl ON (tpl.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_location_ap tl ON (tl.location_id=tpl.location_id) where tp.position_id=? AND tp.position_status = ? AND tp.is_published_for_emp_portal = ? AND tp.employee_publish_from_date <= ? AND tp.employee_publish_to_date >= ? GROUP BY position_id
select requirements from tp_positions where position_id=?
select responsibilities from tp_positions where position_id=?

SELECT DISTINCT tps.skill_id,ts.skill AS skill_name FROM tp_positions tp, tp_position_skills tps LEFT JOIN tp_skills ts ON (tps.skill_id=ts.skill_id) WHERE tp.position_id=tps.position_id AND tp.position_status = ? AND tp.is_published_for_emp_portal = ? AND tp.employee_publish_from_date <= now() AND tp.employee_publish_to_date >= now() @@ ORDER BY skill_name
